Hi Claire / NorBank team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clarity on your user base and regulatory constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap of what we heard:
- Primary requirement: EU-only data residency for production data (customer data, logs, audit trails).
- Preferred deployment: lean toward a managed/hosted option if we can guarantee EU-only processing and KMS integration (bring-your-own-key or customer-managed keys).
- Secondary consideration: APAC latency for a small set of users (~5% of traffic). You mentioned wanting guidance on cross-region routing vs. dedicated capacity in EU.
- Timeline: procurement decision targeted by end of September; security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence requested.

Open questions / asks for NorBank:
1) Can you confirm whether NorBank requires customer-managed KMS (BYOK) or if customer-provided keys via a supported KMS integration (e.g., AWS KMS with grants) is acceptable?
2) Are there any EU countries you must explicitly avoid (e.g., local hosting requirements) or does "EU-only" suffice?
3) Any latency SLA expectations for APAC users that would force a dedicated APAC footprint?

What I can do next (we propose):
- Share our EU-hosted architecture diagram and SOC2 summary (attached).
- Loop in Rafael (solutions engineer) and Mina (security lead) to confirm KMS options and cross-region routing trade-offs.
- Provide a high-level cost delta between Hosted (EU-only), Dedicated EU pool, and Private VPC (on-prem) — plus implications for latency and failover.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, deployment-options-one-pager.pdf

If the above looks right, would it help to schedule a short 30-min technical session next week with your security/infra team so we can walk the options live?

Thanks,

Camila — quick answers below, bullets you can forward to Claire: 

Mina (security) — notes first: we support BYOK via AWS KMS integration and can accept customer-managed keys with a documented grants-based pattern; we also offer a HSM-backed key store for Private VPC deployments. All production logs, KV caches, and audit trails can be configured to remain in EU regions only (no cross-border backups) — we will need to include this as a binding config in the deployment manifest and include it in the DPA.

Dedicated / pricing / lead time (ballpark):
- Min commit: typically 3 months for a Dedicated pool, but we can do month-to-month for smaller reserved blocks for proof-of-concept.
- Lead time: ~2–3 weeks to provision a dedicated EU pool (depends on exact GPU family).
- Ballpark monthly: 4 vGPU-equivalent reserved capacity ~€18k–€25k/mo; 8 vGPU-equivalent ~€34k–€45k/mo. (I will confirm with finance for an exact quote.)

Hosted (EU-only) vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (one-liners for Claire):
- Hosted EU-only: fastest onboarding, lower ops overhead. We can guarantee EU-only processing and provide BYOK via KMS integration as an enterprise option. Good for teams that want lower cost and faster time-to-value.
- Dedicated EU pool: predictable throughput and private capacity; better for strict performance SLAs and sustained high throughput. Slightly higher cost but lower tail latency and noisy-neighbor isolation.
- Private VPC / on-prem: maximum control (keys, networking) and compliance; more expensive and longer lead time. Best when policies require customer-managed network isolation or HSM-only key controls.

APAC latency note:
- If APAC <-> EU RTT is acceptable for their workflows, Hosted EU-only is viable. For low-latency interactive experiences in APAC, add a regional edge or consider Dedicated APAC capacity later. We can implement smart routing: keep EU users in EU, route known APAC traffic to APAC fallback if Dedicated capacity exists. There is no transparent cross-region caching of KV for live GPUs — that needs explicit replication design.

Next steps I recommend we offer them:
1) A 30-min technical session Thurs CET (we'll bring a short diagram showing EU-hosted, Dedicated, and Private VPC flows).
2) A lightweight hosted-EU configuration doc + BYOK integration notes (I will draft).
3) A preliminary pricing sheet for 4/8 vGPU bands and optional BYOK add-on.

I can have the doc + pricing ready by EOD Wed; Mina can add any security caveats.
